invented_facts: The 128 GB configuration “matched and exceeded competitor speeds on those same models”; the paper does not report its 8B result.
The base configuration was “throttled” to 6 tokens/sec; the paper attributes that result to the model not fitting entirely in fast memory, not throttling.
“Competitors with larger, faster GPUs dominate this workload” generalizes a finding about one tested competitor.
notes: The summary omits required test conditions and caveats, including the three-unit median, single competitor configuration, 4-bit quantization and unevaluated output quality, and the video-playback conditions behind the battery rating. It also calls the battery workload “unquantified” when the paper specifies continuous local language-model inference.
